rationale: The current best staged reverse-tail script is still scheduling recurrence by step/ITERATIONS, but official Mac-mini runs stop around 750 steps out of 20,000, so the earlier recurrent block effectively stays near its minimum gain for the whole run. This edit keeps the winning architecture/export path intact and makes the existing staged curriculum advance by actual train-time budget as well as step count, using the same reserved-final-eval budget the launcher already uses. The hypothesis is that this reduces the train/eval mismatch on the first recurrent tail block late in the 600s run without adding new tensors, compile churn, or artifact bytes.
title: Wallclock-Aligned Tail Recurrence Curriculum
